text:
alex: Heads-up: I'm prototyping a small Grafana dashboard for continuous-batching telemetry to help spot regressions. Wanted to get quick feedback on which metrics we should prioritize (batch_util, queue_depth, tokens/sec, token_budget_used, kv_cache_hit).

maria: love it. can we make token_budget a first-class metric? we keep hitting weird tail latency when budgets are exhausted.

alex: yes — thinking of a panel that shows `token_budget_used / token_budget_target` by route/model_variant over time, with a red band at >0.95. also per-model kernel selection breakdown (cuda_fused vs aten) so we can correlate perf regressions with kernel changes.

oliver: +1. also we need a queue depth heatmap by priority class (interactive vs batch) and a histogram for per-request wait_ms before entering a batch.

alex: for queue depth heatmap idea, quick PromQL prototypes: ``sum by(priority, model) (queue_depth)`` and ``histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_wait_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, priority))``. these will be a starting point.

perf-bot: perf snapshot uploaded: /s3/perf/snapshots/2026-04-05/batch-regen-1761283400.tar.gz (diff: avg_tokens/sec -12%, p95 latency +30% vs baseline).

maria: thanks. we should add a panel that ties kv_cache_hit_rate to tokens/sec — when hit rate drops, tokens/sec should fall and queue depth spikes. Example query: ``sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[1m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_lookups_total[1m]))``.

alex: good call. I'll add a composite panel: left = batch_utilization (tokens emitted / token_capacity), center = queue_depth by priority, right = kv_cache_hit_rate with annotation for deploy times.

oliver: what about alerting? recommend alerts: (1) queue_depth > 100 for >2m for interactive routes, (2) avg_tokens/sec drop >20% vs 15m baseline, (3) token_budget_utilization > 0.95 for >5m.

alex: draft alert rule examples: ``expr: avg_over_time(sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (model)[15m:1m]) < (0.8 * avg_over_time(sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (model)[2h:1m]))`` with severity=page for critical models.

sachin: also include per-kernel charing: ``sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total{kernel!=""}[1m])) by (kernel)`` so we can detect kernel-level regressions. sometimes a kernel swap kills perf for specific seq lengths.

maria: UI/UX ask — can we do a small overlay showing current batching policy (max_wait_ms, token_budget_target) so SREs can see policy + metrics side-by-side?

alex: yep plan to show current policy as a small JSON snippet pinned to the dashboard, updated from config-service via a lightweight endpoint. e.g. ``{"max_wait_ms":8, "token_budget_target":1024, "batch_size_target":16}``.

perf-bot: quick profiling note: when batch_util drops under 0.5 for p50 seq_len>1024, kernel fallback to aten occurs in ~60s after config rollout. putting this in the panel as an event annotation helps correlate.

sachin: can we add a compact table: model, current_kernel, avg_batch_size, batch_util, kv_hit, tokens/sec, p95_wait_ms — sortable. helps triage fast.

alex: will add. timeline: i'll push an MVP dashboard with those panels + the 3 alerts by EOD tomorrow. dropping a link here when ready for review.

maria: awesome, please tag me. i can help pick alert thresholds for customer-critical routes. :thumbsup:

oliver: thanks alex — this will help a ton during releases.

alex: posted: https://grafana.internal/r/d/abc123/batching-telemetry-mvp (MVP up, panels + alerts wired to alertmanager). feedback welcome.

maria: checking it now.

sachin: saw one nit: the kernel breakdown panel uses absolute tokens/sec; can we add normalized tokens/sec per-GPU to compare clusters?

alex: good call — adding tokens_per_gpu normalization. will update alerting thresholds accordingly.

perf-bot: automated note: next nightly profiler scheduled at 2026-04-06T02:00Z.

alex: closing loop here — thanks all, will iterate after first-day signal.
